newsitem.title: USA: Compaq unveils line of business notebooks.
newsitem.headline: Compaq unveils line of business notebooks.

text.p: Compaq Computer Corp on Monday unveiled a new line of business notebook computers priced as low as $1,999, the company said.
Compaq's Armada 1500 series is meant to be a value-prices line, equiped 120 MHz or 133 MHz Pentium processors, hard drive, diskette drive, CD-ROM drive and 33.6 kilobytes-per-second modem.
The firm also said it also began U.S. promotional price reductions between eight up to 35 percent on select models of its Armada 4100 and Armada 1100 family.
Compaq plans to introduce an Armada 1500 notebook early in the third quarter which includes Intel Corp's MMX processor.
In addition, the company announced that it will extend its promotional pricing offer of $199 on its Mobile CD Unit for customers who purchase an Armada 4100 notebook through June 30.
